mapper.sql: a.id, a.entity_type, a.entity_id, a.file_name, a.url, a.content_type, a.size, a.uploaded_by_id, a.created_at, a.updated_at, u.display_name AS uploaded_by_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.uploaded_by_id WHERE a.entity_type = #{entityType} AND a.entity_id = #{entityId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.uploaded_by_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment WHERE entity_type = #{entityType} AND entity_id = #{entityId}
